svg.title: Vulkanizer .vkmesh version 4 binary file layout
svg.desc: A protocol-style 32-bit field diagram. Fixed header fields are followed by vertex layout, meshes, bounds, indices, vertices, instances, lights, and embedded images. Scalars use native byte order, not network byte order. Variable blocks are collapsed.
svg.text: Native-endian cache (little-endian on current Windows builds), not network byte order.
Ruler positions show field width; they do not specify integer bit significance.
// = multiword block, collapsed vertically; no padding is added between sections.
Offsets after the binding array depend on preceding counts and byte lengths.
Record sizes shown for the current unaligned GLM/native ABI. Geometry arrays are raw records.
Companion files: .vkmat = materials + samplers + texture references; .vkbounds = bounds copy.
Source of truth: src/mesh.cpp :: save_mesh_data() / include/vulkanizer/mesh.hpp
